title: Ginger-Soy Chicken & Bok Choy Braise
description: Sketched out but never written up. The Sesame Chicken Noodles came out of the same session and took the sauce base in a looser direction.

confidence.note: Direction only. Sketched out but never written up.

items.item: soy, ginger and garlic sauce base

steps.text: Braise the chicken in the soy-ginger-garlic sauce.
Add the green beans with about 5–6 minutes left, the bok choy stems a couple of minutes after that, and the leafy tops right at the end.

notes.title: Texture
notes.text: Bok choy and green beans braise rather than char in the Thermomix, and beans especially go khaki if overcooked. A quick blast in the air fryer is the hybrid move.
